name: Almwirtschaft Acherberg
kurzbeschreibung:
**Alpine Dairy Farm Acherberg in Tirol**

Discover the authentic charm of the **Almwirtschaft Acherberg** nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. Perched high in the mountains, this traditional dairy farm invites you to savor the pure flavors of the Alps.

Indulge in freshly prepared **Tiroler Gröstl**, hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, and creamy **Käsekrainer**—all made with local ingredients. Enjoy your meal on the sunny terrace with breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks.

A perfect stop for hikers and families, the **Acherberg** offers a cozy retreat after a day exploring **Tirol’s** stunning landscapes. Try their homemade **Speckknödel** or **Apfelstrudel** for a sweet finish.

Open seasonally, this hidden gem is a must-visit for anyone seeking a taste of **Tirol’s** rustic hospitality.
